title: Concave Shape of the Yield Curve and No Arbitrage
abstract: arXiv:1808.03481v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In fixed income sector, the yield curve is probably the most observed indicator by the market for trading and fifinancing purposes. A yield curve plots interest rates across different contract maturities from short end to as long as 30 years. For each currency, the corresponding curve shows the relation between the level of the interest rates (or cost of borrowing) and the time to maturity. For example, the U.S. dollar interest rates paid on U.S. Treasury securities for various maturities are plotted as the US treasury curve. For the same currency, if the swap market is used, we could also plot the swap rates across the tenors which would be called the swap curve.Even the yield curve can be at, upward or downward (inverted), however, yield curve is generally concave. There is a lack of explanation of the concavity of the yield curve shape from economics theory. We offer in this article an explanation of the concavity shape of the yie

translated_title: 收益率曲线的凹形形态与无套利
translated_abstract: 在固定收益领域，收益率曲线可能是市场出于交易和融资目的而最常观察的指标。收益率曲线描绘了从短期端到长达30年的不同合约期限下的利率。对于每种货币，相应的曲线显示了利率水平（或借贷成本）与到期时间之间的关系。例如，美国国债在不同期限下支付的美元利率绘制出来即为美国国债收益率曲线。对于同一货币，如果使用互换市场，我们也可以绘制不同期限的互换利率，这被称为互换曲线。尽管收益率曲线可以是平坦的、向上倾斜或向下倾斜（倒挂）的，但收益率曲线通常呈凹形。经济学理论缺乏对收益率曲线凹形形态的解释。我们在本文中对收益率曲线的凹形形态提供了一种解释。
tldr: 本文从无套利角度为收益率曲线普遍呈凹形这一现象提供了理论解释，填补了经济学理论在此方面的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a no-arbitrage-based explanation for the generally concave shape of the yield curve, filling a gap in economic theory.
